import of a host package (single or grouped)
error declaration to a struct type
record to a struct type (field syntax, i64 to int64)
enum to an interface union with one struct per variant
service to an interface
service or impl method signature (raises to error[...])
impl to a struct type with receiver methods
impl constructor parameters to struct fields read through the receiver
pure fn signature
effect fn signature (raises and uses to a result list, error[...] and uses)
tail expression to return
if/else expression to if with returns
fail E to return E{}
let x = run e to x := try e
let x = e to x := e
run e as a statement to e
Console.log to Console.Println, and provide<Console>(Stdout) dropped
provide<S>(Impl) to with(wire{ S = Impl{} })
provide(Layer) to with(Layer)
layer to wire with value entries
catch<E>(v) chain to one catch block with a case per error
timeout(n) to timeout.After(n ms), and Timeout to timeout.Expired
match to a type switch with a binder, an arm to a case with return
variant pattern field bindings to binder field reads
match on two subjects to a two-subject switch with case tuples
Enum.Variant literal or positional constructor to a Variant struct literal
field shorthand to name: name
scope block to the function-body scope
fork to go, interrupt to Stop
decision words to Decision literals, decision<> to Decision[]
machine declaration to type machine[State, Event]
method name case and duration literals (sleep(10000) to Sleep(10000ms))
